name: Quantum machine learning
blurb: Variational circuits, quantum kernels, and the question of whether any of it beats a laptop.

touchstones.text: variational quantum circuits trained on data for classification or regression
quantum kernels and feature maps for classification
barren plateaus and trainability of parameterized circuits
data encoding and the expressivity of quantum models
classical shadows and learning from quantum measurements
dequantization and classical simulation of quantum learning claims
interpretable quantum machine learning with logic-gate or clause-based classifiers, e.g. quantum Tsetlin machines
quantum machine learning models built from interference and oracle algorithms, e.g. Bernstein-Vazirani-style learning networks
